messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm planning a soft-unpin of runtime-3.4 for the recommendation-model group tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Before I open the window, want to confirm pin-exemption criteria for multi-model reroutes (models that must stay pinned even if runtime unpinned).
ash: Do we have a concise list of compatibility signals we trust for exemption? e.g., longseq token growth, kv-cache format mismatch, custom kernel flags.
konstantin: short answer: yes. Primary signals: serialization schema version, kv-cache keyshape, and runtime-kernel ABI. Secondary: perf regressions >10% and QA eval failures.
qa-liz: For this cohort I ran the smoke suite against runtime-3.4 unpinned with model variants A/B/C — two failures on A (memory spike on longseq). I think A should be exempted until we patch.
maria: OK — thinking of an exemption rule like: if any model in group reports memory OOM or >8% p50 latency reg vs baseline, add to pin-exempt list automatically and reroute traffic to runtime-3.3. Should that be a hard rule?
ash: I'd make memory OOM a hard rule. Latency delta up to 12% could be a soft-exempt with canary gating. We should avoid mass exemptions from noisy signals.
samir: Can we capture this as a small JSON snippet for the deploybot to evaluate? E.g.

```
{
  "exempt_if": {
    "oom": true,
    "p50_latency_regression_pct": 8,
    "kv_cache_schema_mismatch": true
  },
  "action": "pin-exempt + reroute to pinned-runtime",
  "notify": ["#eng-releases","#eng-oncall"]
}
```

konstantin: That looks fine. Add a flag to require >=3 consecutive failing canary checks before automatic exemption to avoid flapping.
qa-liz: Agreed. Also add a manual-override label so platform can force-exempt during a hotfix.
ops-bot: @maria deploy window check: free GPU capacity in EU region between 01:45-03:30 UTC tomorrow: 4/6 nodes idle. No conflicting reserved capacity flagged.
maria: Thanks @ops-bot. I'll schedule the window at 02:00 UTC then. Plan: start canary 02:00 (1%), monitor 15m, expand to 10% if green, full roll at 03:00. Auto-exempt criteria as above with 3 consecutive canary failures.
ash: One more ask — we need the deploybot to append a note to the release notes when it triggers an automatic exemption. Otherwise PMs won't see which models were kept pinned.
samir: I can add that. Proposed format appended to release notes:

- auto-exempted models: [model-id] reason: [oom|kv-schema|latency] canary-checks: [3]

maria: perfect.
deploybot: Scheduling unpin job: job_id=unpin-5401234567-01 window=2026-05-03T02:00:00Z canary_params={percent:1,duration_min:15,consecutive_failures:3}
deploybot: Will post status updates to this thread and to #eng-oncall.
konstantin: Please ensure the pinlist store is versioned. If we auto-exempt we should write a new pinlist revision like pinlist@20260503T0200 with metadata.
ash: add: rollback plan if we see elevated 5xxs: immediate revert to pinned runtime and alert SRE channel.
qa-liz: I'll prepare a short test matrix and attach perf traces to the rollforward checklist.
maria: attaching the canary checklist in the deploy description — small snippet:

```
- start canary 1% (02:00)
- monitor: p50/p95 latency, oom count, 5xxs, kv-schema-errors
- if 0 failures -> expand to 10% (02:15)
- if 0 failures at 10% -> full roll (03:00)
- if >=3 consecutive failures -> auto-exempt affected models, pinlist rev++, notify
```

samir: one implementation note: deploybot needs read access to pinlist-write key (scoped) and must sign the pinlist revision with deploybot identity.
ops-bot: Access gate OK, I added deploybot-scoped key to vault with least privilege.
maria: Great. Last call: anyone objects to the ruleset? Otherwise I'll proceed to open the official change window and run the canary.
ash: No objections from infra side.
konstantin: No objections, just watch the longseqs on model A.
qa-liz: Uploading trace logs to the ticket now.
maria: Thanks team — will post the job link once deploybot creates it.
deploybot: job created: https://deploy.redwood.ai/jobs/unpin-5401234567-01 status=scheduled (will update here)

maria: (edited) added a quick manual rollback command in the runbook: `./deploy rollback --job unpin-5401234567-01 --to-runtime runtime-3.3` — use only after confirming SRE ack.

samir: noted. I'll instrument the release notes hook to include a short JSON blob for telemetry that surfaces which models were auto-exempted.

ops-bot: reminder: update oncall rotation covers 02:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow: oncall=sre-crew-2.

maria: closing the thread for now, will reopen with live deploy updates. :white_check_mark:
